2608.06765.title: LiFTER: A Grounded Neuro-Symbolic Microscope for Continuous-Time Dynamic Graph Forecasting
2608.06765.paper_summary: Continuous-time dynamic graph models predict future links by compressing past interactions into neural states. Although effective for forecasting, this computation obscures which entities are shared across events and how temporal patterns contribute to a prediction. We treat this gap as a property of the predictive architecture rather than a problem to be addressed after prediction. Link-Fact Temporal Rule Inducer (LiFTER) is a neuro-symbolic predictor that preserves observed interactions as grounded temporal facts and applies executable tempo- ral rules to pre-query facts. Each score is a signed sum of rule exe- cutions whose historical facts, entity bindings, and temporal order are explicitly satisfied. The evidence and rules responsible for a prediction can therefore be inspected, independently recomputed, and intervened upon. Across four CTDG benchmarks, LiFTER achieves competitive historical-negative forecasting and the highest macro explanation ac- curacy and deletion fidelity. The same architecture also serves as a microscope that separates the contributions of recurrence, history po- sition, and transition across datasets and traces them to individual facts. Independent execution reconstructs all logits for 19,664 test predictions with a maximum error of 0.0000131. LiFTER turns future-link forecasting into a verifiable grounded computation.
2608.06765.paper_summary_zh: 持續時間動態圖模型通過將過去的互動壓縮為神經狀態來預測未來的連結。雖然這種計算對於預測有效，但卻模糊了事件之間共享的實體以及時間模式如何對預測做出貢獻。我們將這一差距視為預測架構的一個特性，而不是預測後需要解決的問題。鏈接事實時間規則引導器（LiFTER）是一種神經符號預測器，它將觀察到的互動作為基於時間的事實進行保留，並對預查事實應用可執行的時間規則。每個分數都是規則執行的有符號總和，其歷史事實、實體綁定和時間順序都明確滿足。因此，負責預測的證據和規則可以被檢查、獨立重新計算和介入。在四個CTDG基準測試中，LiFTER實現了具有競爭力的歷史負面預測，以及最高的宏觀解釋準確性和刪除忠實度。同一架構還作為顯微鏡，分離重複性、歷史位置和轉換在數據集中的貢獻，並將其追溯到個別事實。獨立執行重建了19,664個測試預測的所有logits，最大誤差為0.0000131。LiFTER將未來連結預測轉變為可驗證的基於事實的計算。
